title: 037 addendum 3: M-of-N vote of raw buy signals vs the width book
status: ADDED AFTER the 037 lock at the user's request, after the tb and tbatr screens were read; committed before any M-of-N score

labels.secondary: label:tb_buy (fixed +2%/-5%: what the current fixed-% exits pay)

pool: every raw_buy signal in a tbatr pair SURVIVOR (pairs_label_tbatr_buy.json, either population; selected on early + E0, confirmation status NOT used): 33 signals
members: early windows, all bars, primary label: phi correlation of fires, average-linkage clusters cut at phi >= 0.3; one member per cluster = highest early median single lift; the 8 clusters whose member lifts most (N <= 8)
score: count of members firing; signal = count >= M
choice_of_M: early windows, primary label, per population: M_best = highest early median lift (computable in >= 6 early windows); M_match = early median fire rate closest to the width book's
confirm: per M in {M_best, M_match}, per population, on both labels: yes = late median lift > width book's late median AND > the best single member's late median, AND E0 lift >= width book's E0 lift and >= 1; early+late only = E0 fails; else no
benchmark: per fold: logistic regression on the N member signals (training rows to 48 bars before the fold start, hourly, data_ok) vs the count score, test-window AUC on the primary label; descriptive
seen_before: tb and tbatr single and pair screens (all halves)
label_note: SCREEN (descriptive); any survivor needs a backtest as a trigger (alone and with the width book)
